report:
The study reveals normal knee joint alignment.  
  Small osteochondral lesion, about 7mm., at weightbearing part of the lateral femoral condyle is noted.  
    Mild surrounding bone marrow edema is observed. NO definite osteochondral fragment is detected. 
   No cartilagenous tear is detected.  
   FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved. 
    Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
  The MCL is intact.   Medial meniscus is not torn.  
   Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen. 
   Normal course with preserved signal of the ACL is noted.  The PCL is intact.  
  The PF joint surface is preserved.   No subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
    The quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.    Small osteochondral lesion, about 7mm., at weightbearing part of the lateral femoral condyle,  
 probably represent early stage osteochondritis dissecans.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear of the anterior root, anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a dominant horizontal component and a para meniscal cyst abutting the meniscal body. There is mild meniscal extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness cartilage fissuring along the posterior weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss spanning the median ridge and lateral patellar facet with subchondral cystic change. Full-thickness cartilage loss at the periphery of the lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. There is patella alta Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tearing of the lateral meniscus with dominant horizontal component, associated parameniscal cyst, and mild lateral compartment chondrosis.

2. Findings suggestive of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, mild Hoffa's fat pad impingement, mild distal quadriceps tendinosis, and patella alta configuration.

3. Small joint effusion and moderate Baker's cyst.

МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив.  Вижда се изразен костномозъчен едем в латерален фемурален кондил, разположен предимно епифизарно и в по-слаба степен метафизарно. В латералното плато на фемура сред описания едем, субхондрално се вижда хипоинтензна линия, следваща хода на ставния хрущял. Няма данни за депресия на костта. Хиалинният хрущял на тибията и фемура двустранно е съхранен. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна линеарна лезия с кос ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията – grade 3. Не се изобразяват патологични лезии в останалите менискуси. Нормално изобразяване на предната и задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Едем на меките тъкани в поплитеалната ямка.  Патела – малки субхондрални кисти под хрущяла на пателата. Ретинакулуми на пателата и хрущял на пателата с нормален МР образ. Заключение: МР данни за SIF (subchondral insuffiency fracture) на латералния фемурален кондил. Ставен излив. Лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Tendinopatía rotuliana izquierda
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras
condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa de la rótula, sin cambios óseos
secundarios.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano con cambios entesopáticos por su
aspecto lateral y mínimos cambios óseos secundarios regionales.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
No hay derrame articular y quistes poplíteos.
Impresión:
Tendinosis rotuliana proximal con cambios entesopáticos insercionales proximales por lateral y
mínimos cambios óseos secundarios regionales.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula
